scenes.say: Do you know which muscles squats really work?

scenes.label: QUADS — THE MAIN MOVER
scenes.say: First, the quads. They do most of the work.

scenes.label: GLUTES WORK HARD
scenes.say: Your glutes fire hard, especially when you go deep.

scenes.label: HAMSTRINGS HELP
scenes.say: Your hamstrings help you stand back up.

scenes.label: ABS KEEP YOU STABLE
scenes.say: Your abs brace your torso and protect your back.

scenes.label: CALVES? BARELY
scenes.say: Your calves barely work. Train them with calf raises.

scenes.label: ARMS? NOT AT ALL
scenes.say: And your arms do almost nothing.

scenes.label: QUADS + GLUTES + ABS
scenes.say: Quads, glutes and abs. Save this and try it today.
